purpose: Package the implemented DMRV and blockchain evidence infrastructure as a measurable builder/grant work package without representing funding as awarded.

excluded_until_authorized: physical water production without site authorization

work_packages.name: Deterministic DMRV package builder
work_packages.acceptance: Identical canonical inputs produce identical evidence roots.

work_packages.name: Blockchain evidence anchor
work_packages.acceptance: A test evidence root can be anchored and independently verified.

work_packages.name: Public verification
work_packages.acceptance: Verifier exposes integrity state without exposing secrets or sensitive locations.

work_packages.name: Security and governance
work_packages.acceptance: Security review evidence is retained and unresolved critical findings block release.

work_packages.name: VDR evidence package
work_packages.acceptance: An external reviewer can reconstruct the controlled demonstration from the VDR.

funding_evidence.claim_rule: Funding application status must be represented as PROPOSED, SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, AWARDED, DECLINED or WITHDRAWN; never imply AWARDED without documentary evidence.
